mechanism_narrative: The steady four-week improvement in TRANSIT from -51.4 to -46.3 signals that residents are resuming out-of-home routines; this commuting recovery lifts retail and recreation footfall, so RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -51.4 at t-3w to -46.3 at t-0w
